title: Cousin Paris Jones, trumpeter and teacher
summary: Second cousin Paris Jones taught Kenny Dorham, played jazz trumpet and stayed in Texas as a professor.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: But now, we was kept away on my mother's side, going back to my cousins. Now, they all sang and played. And I had the other cousins that were like Louise Jones. Her husband -- she and her husband were both great musicians. And her son, Paris Jones, was the one that Kenny Dorham actually learned from. They were like brothers. And when Diz came to Texas, he'd always look for my second cousin, Paris Jones
He played trumpet, and he was one of the greatest in the United States. But he wouldn't leave Texas. He was a professor, he taught.
Did he play jazz, or legitimate stuff
Diz and them are afraid of him.
Playing jazz. Yeah Kenny Dorham will tell you in a minute, if you want to hear something, he'll say, go down and hear your cousin. But he passed away very young, last year.
But let's see if I can think of --
